questions.question: When 716, 1837 and 2545 are divided by the greatest number x, the remainder in each case is y. What is the value of (x - y)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers: 716, 1837, 2545

Remainder = y (same for all)

**Formula used:**

If the remainder is same, then (difference between numbers) is divisible by the required divisor x.

**Calculations:**

So, x = HCF of (1837 − 716), (2545 − 1837)

⇒ 1837 − 716 = 1121

⇒ 2545 − 1837 = 708

Now, find HCF(1121, 708):

⇒ 1121 ÷ 708 = 1 remainder 413

⇒ 708 ÷ 413 = 1 remainder 295

⇒ 413 ÷ 295 = 1 remainder 118

⇒ 295 ÷ 118 = 2 remainder 59

⇒ 118 ÷ 59 = 2 remainder 0

⇒ HCF = 59

So, x = 59

Now, remainder y = 716 mod 59

⇒ 59 × 12 = 708 ⇒ remainder = 8

⇒ y = 8

⇒ (x − y) = 59 − 8 = 51

**∴ (x − y) = 51**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 15,625 amounts to Rs. 19,600 in 2 years ata certain rate per cent per annum when the interest is compounded yearly. The same sum will amount to Rs. x in one year at the same rate when the interest is compounded half-yearly. The value of x is (nearest to an integer):
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 15,625

Amount after 2 years = Rs. 19,600

Time = 2 years

Compounding = Yearly

Compounding for 1 year = Half-yearly

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Amount = Principal × (1 + Rate ÷ n)ⁿ×t

Rate = [(Amount ÷ Principal)¹/t − 1] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Rate = [(19,600 ÷ 15,625)¹/² − 1] × 100

⇒ Rate = [(1.2544)¹/² − 1] × 100

⇒ Rate = [1.118 − 1] × 100

⇒ Rate = 0.118 × 100

⇒ Rate = 11.8%

For compounding half-yearly:

⇒ Amount = Principal × (1 + Rate ÷ n)ⁿ×t

⇒ Amount = 15,625 × (1 + 11.8 ÷ 200)²×¹

⇒ Amount = 15,625 × (1 + 0.059)²

⇒ Amount = 15,625 × (1.059)²

⇒ Amount = 15,625 × 1.121

⇒ Amount = Rs. 17,556

**∴ The correct answer is 17556.**

questions.question: 48 persons working 8 hours a day can do a certain work in 25 days. In how many days, will 15 persons working 10 hours a day do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

48 persons working 8 hours/day can complete work in 25 days.

15 persons working 10 hours/day need to complete the same work.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Number of persons × Hours/day × Days

Days required = Total work ÷ (Number of persons × Hours/day)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = 48 × 8 × 25

⇒ Total work = 9600

⇒ Days required = 9600 ÷ (15 × 10)

⇒ Days required = 9600 ÷ 150

⇒ Days required = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

questions.question: The perimeter of a trapezium is 104 cm, its non parallel sides are 20 cm each, and the distance between its parallel sides is 16 cm. The area (in cm) of the trapezium is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of trapezium = 104 cm

Non-parallel sides = 20 cm each

Distance between parallel sides = 16 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of trapezium = (1/2) × (Sum of parallel sides) × Distance between parallel sides

Perimeter = Sum of all sides

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of non-parallel sides = 20 + 20 = 40 cm

⇒ Sum of parallel sides = Perimeter - Sum of non-parallel sides

⇒ Sum of parallel sides = 104 - 40 = 64 cm

⇒ Let parallel sides be x and y such that x + y = 64 cm

⇒ Area = (1/2) × (x + y) × Distance between parallel sides

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 64 × 16

⇒ Area = 32 × 16

⇒ Area = 512 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 512.**

questions.question: There are 4 numbers. The average of the first 3 numbers is three times the 4th number, If the average of all the 4 numbers is 35, then the 4th number lies between:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of first 3 numbers = 3 × 4th number

Average of all 4 numbers = 35

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all terms ÷ Number of terms

Sum = Average × Number of terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the 4th number = x

⇒ Average of first 3 numbers = 3x

⇒ Sum of first 3 numbers = 3 × 3x = 9x

⇒ Total sum of all 4 numbers = 9x + x = 10x

⇒ Average of all 4 numbers = (10x ÷ 4) = 35

⇒ 10x = 140

⇒ x = 14

Since the 4th number = 14,

**∴ The 4th number lies between 12 and 15.**

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 1,200. During a sale, three successive discounts of 20%», 16% and x% are offered on this marked price. If the article is sold for Rs. 685.44, then shat is the value of x
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 1200

Successive discounts = 20%, 16%, x%

Final selling price = Rs. 685.44

**Formula Used:**

Final Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount1) × (1 - Discount2) × (1 - Discount3)

Discount = Percentage ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Final Price = Rs. 1200 × (1 - 20 ÷ 100) × (1 - 16 ÷ 100) × (1 - x ÷ 100)

⇒ Rs. 685.44 = Rs. 1200 × 0.8 × 0.84 × (1 - x ÷ 100)

⇒ Rs. 685.44 = Rs. 806.4 × (1 - x ÷ 100)

⇒ (1 - x ÷ 100) = Rs. 685.44 ÷ Rs. 806.4

⇒ (1 - x ÷ 100) = 0.85

⇒ x ÷ 100 = 1 - 0.85

⇒ x ÷ 100 = 0.15

⇒ x = 0.15 × 100

⇒ x = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

questions.question: The price of an article was first increased by x% and then the new price was decreased by x%. If the last price was Rs. 10 x , then the original price (in Rs.) of the article was:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Last price = Rs. 10x

**Formula Used:**

New price after increase = Original price × (1 + x ÷ 100)

Final price after decrease = New price × (1 - x ÷ 100)

Final price = Original price × [1 - (x ÷ 100)²]

Original price = Final price ÷ [1 - (x ÷ 100)²]

**Calculation:**

⇒ Original price = 10x ÷ [1 - (x ÷ 100)²]

**∴ The correct answer is (10x)/([1-(x ÷ 100)²]).**

questions.question: The external and internal radii of a hollow metallic spherical shell are 10 cm and 6 cm, respectively, It is melted and recast into solid balls of radius 2 cm each. The number of balls will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Outer radius = 10 cm

Inner radius = 6 cm

Radius of each small ball = 2 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = (4 ÷ 3) × π × radius³

Number of balls = Volume of shell ÷ Volume of one ball

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume of shell = (4 ÷ 3) × π × (10³ − 6³)

⇒ 10³ = 1000 and 6³ = 216

⇒ Volume of shell = (4 ÷ 3) × π × (1000 − 216) = (4 ÷ 3) × π × 784

⇒ Volume of one ball = (4 ÷ 3) × π × 2³ = (4 ÷ 3) × π × 8

⇒ Number of balls = [(4 ÷ 3) × π × 784] ÷ [(4 ÷ 3) × π × 8]

⇒ Number of balls = 784 ÷ 8 = 98

**∴ The correct answer is 98.**
